# GlassesResearch

> Independent, evidence-tracked research on smart glasses, AI eyewear, lineages, capabilities, owner control, and wearable human-computer interaction. Unknown facts remain unknown; lineage does not inherit claims or scores.

## Start here

- [GlassesResearch](https://glassesresearch.org/): Main research surface, current highlights, Finder, and paths into the catalog.
- [Contents](https://glassesresearch.org/docs/CONTENTS/): Human-readable map of the site.
- [Research & News](https://glassesresearch.org/docs/RESEARCH_NEWS/): Verified research updates and publication stream.
- [Research standards](https://glassesresearch.org/docs/RESEARCH_STANDARDS/): Evidence and verification standards used by the project.

## Models and ecosystem

- [Canonical model catalog](https://glassesresearch.org/models/catalog/): Stable GLS model identities and model pages.
- [Report Cards](https://glassesresearch.org/docs/REPORT_CARD/): Core model assessments with unknown states preserved.
- [Lineages](https://glassesresearch.org/lineages/): Rebrands, families, and ecosystem relationships without claim inheritance.
- [Industry timeline](https://glassesresearch.org/docs/INDUSTRY_TIMELINE/): Preserved smart-glasses and wearable-HCI history.
- [Community and development resources](https://glassesresearch.org/resources/COMMUNITY_AND_DEVELOPMENT/): Development communities, SDK resources, and owner-control paths.

## Data and reuse

- [Open Smart-Glasses Dataset](https://glassesresearch.org/dataset/): Canonical JSON/CSV exports, schema, checksums, versioned releases, Frictionless Data Package, and DCAT metadata.
- [Reference Desk](https://glassesresearch.org/docs/REFERENCE_DESK/): Stable identifiers and reusable research references.
- [How to cite GlassesResearch](https://glassesresearch.org/docs/CITING_GLASSESRESEARCH/): Citation guidance and machine-readable citation formats.
- [Verified changes RSS](https://glassesresearch.org/feed.xml): RSS feed for verified research changes.

## Optional

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/theGreenJedi/GlassesResearch): Source, issue tracker, research data, and project history.
